title: Arkansas (SSN 800) Christening Bottle Break
description:
Carlotta Walls LaNier, a ship’s sponsor for Arkansas (SSN 800), delivered remarks and smashed a bottle of American sparkling wine across the submarine’s bow during last weekend’s christening ceremony at Newport News Shipbuilding. LaNier – a member of the Little Rock Nine – performed the traditional honor on behalf of the other members. The Little Rock Nine made history in 1957 when they became the first African American students to integrate Central High School in Little Rock, Arkansas. 

The six women of the Little Rock Nine are the ship’s sponsors. NNS honored all nine members during the christening ceremony.
